thread:
maria: Heads-up — RC-2026.03 scheduled for EU canary in ~2h. SBOM scan showed a base-image identity mismatch (cosign verify failed). We need signed provenance/evidence or a decision to carve out EU canary. Ping @legal-review @rohan @elaine.

deploybot: SBOM scan report uploaded. Summary: base-image `redwood/base:2026.03` -> signature not found for layer 3. Full artifact: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/rc-2026.03/sbom (uploaded)

rohan: can you paste the `cosign verify` output? could be detached sig, or registry ACLs blocking signature retrieval.

deploybot: cosign verify output:
```
ERROR: no matching signatures found for image
```
Also pushed the signature blob to internal storage: s3://rb-inference-artifacts/rc-2026.03/cosign.sig

elaine: quick risk question — is this a showstopper for EU canary? any customer-facing P0s in this RC?

maria: no P0 customer-facing changes, mostly infra/perf fixes. Main issue: provenance for base image. Legal/compliance prefers signed attestation for EU regulated customers, so we need a path forward.

legal-review: we need one of: (1) successful `cosign verify`, (2) a signed SBOM + attestation (in registry), or (3) explicit acceptance from compliance. If we carve out eu-canary we must record the exception and update release notes.

sre-oncall: operationally we can do a regional carveout: deploy to `eu-west-nonprod` + `us` and block `eu-prod`. That preserves infra checks. `deploybot` can run a staged rollout with `--regions=eu-west-nonprod,us-east-1`.

maria: Proposed path: timebox 2 hours for rohan to attempt re-sign / verify or fetch evidence. If no evidence by +2h, perform EU carveout (non-prod only) and update release notes with an exception. Also plan: if legal insists, pin base-image to previous digest as fallback. Sound good? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

rohan: I’ll re-run cosign against the registry and check ACLs and the signing pipeline. Will try re-pushing detached signature if needed and post logs here. @deploybot please hold the final promote until I report back.

deploybot: acknowledged — holding final promote. When ready I can run a staged promote with `--regions=eu-west-nonprod,us-east-1` or full canary if verified.

maria: thanks. I’ll log this decision in the release notes and in #eng-releases. If rohan confirms signature inside the window we revert to full canary. Otherwise we proceed with carveout and pin fallback.

rohan: posting initial debug note: registry returned 403 on signature fetch; suspect ephemeral tokens expired. Re-running signer job now.

maria: ok — please update here asap. If we need to escalate to infra infra-team ping.

legal-review: also add a short note for customers: "EU canary limited due to pending provenance verification; no customer-facing changes expected; full canary resumes when attestation available." Keep it in release notes under "Compliance exceptions."

maria: agreed. Updating release notes template now. Will mark action: `timebox-rc-2026.03-provenance` and set owner=`rohan`.

sre-oncall: reminder: if we carve out, ensure rollback/runbook is tested for eu-prod to prevent accidental promotion.

maria: noted. Everyone — thanks. If verified within window we'll proceed normally. If not, carveout+note. :white_check_mark:
